# Users API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

The Users app exposes accounts, groups, laboratories and the invitation and request records that manage membership.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`user`](/api/users/user/) | A person with a BrainSTEM account, who receives roles directly or through groups. | private, public |
| [`group`](/api/users/group/) | A set of users, such as a lab or a team, that can be given a role as one. | private, public |
| [`laboratory`](/api/users/laboratory/) | Laboratory records. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`groupmembershipinvitation`](/api/users/groupmembershipinvitation/) | Group membership invitation records. | private |
| [`groupmembershiprequest`](/api/users/groupmembershiprequest/) | Group membership request records. | private |
| [`pendinginvitation`](/api/users/pendinginvitation/) | An invitation by email to someone without an account yet, for a role on a group, project or personal attribute; it takes effect when they sign up. | private |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/users/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
